observations: A large rounded head shape is outlined in thick white against a black background, filled with overlapping colored lines in red, blue, yellow, teal, and magenta that cross without resolving into flat areas.
Two eye sockets contain star and angular mark shapes in orange-yellow; a mouth below shows a row of white rectangular teeth between dark lips, with a red tongue extending to the right.

reading: The thick white outline cuts the head from its scribbled surround, making the interior feel compressed rather than contained. Layered lines in clashing colors sit on top of each other without blending, so the face reads as accumulated marks rather than modeled form. The bared teeth and extended tongue carry a rawness that the star-shaped eye marks amplify. The surrounding black field, dense with its own scrawl, reads as equally agitated.
